<EvidenceFact>
  <EvidenceAnchor id="fact-c1850276-blocking-fet-topology" />

  **Fact:** `fact-c1850276-blocking-fet-topology`

  **Value:** External blocking N-FET Q1: source to IN\_SYS, drain to IN, gate to B\_GATE (back-to-back with the internal FET). Pulldown signal FET Q2 across B\_GATE, DRV and IN\_SYS; Q2 must be at least 15 V VDS, 20 V VGS maximum rating, Ciss \<= 50 pF and VGTH(min) \<= 3 V. · **Unit:** `NONE`

  **Conditions:** Required for reverse polarity protection and reverse current blocking; without it IN\_SYS and IN are shorted and B\_GATE/DRV left open. RCB comparator V(REVTH) -20/-15/-9 mV; tRCB(dly) 0.48/3 us typ/max at 10 mV overdrive.

  **Verdict:** PASS - primary-source confirmed · **Provenance:** PRIMARY-SPEC

  **Evidence:** [`src-c1850276-primary`](#src-c1850276-primary) — Section 8.3.5 Input Reverse Polarity Protection (B\_GATE, DRV), Figures 8-7 and 8-8 pages 20-21; Table 6.6 RCB rows
</EvidenceFact>

| `RECOMMENDED_OPERATION` | The range the manufacturer intends the part to be used in. Always narrower than the absolute maximum.                                                              |
| `THERMAL_SOA`           | Thermal and safe-operating-area behaviour: how much the part may dissipate, and under what mounting and ambient conditions.                                        |
| `TYPICAL_CURVE`         | A representative figure read from a characteristic curve. Typical values are not guaranteed and vary part to part.                                                 |

| `OPEN`        | Unresolved. Open means the question has not been answered, not that the part is unsafe — the reason states what is missing. |
